about: The Metal engine's defaults on an Apple-Silicon Mac. All experts use the resident GPU path (--mmap-experts --no-prefill-borrow), 1024-token prompt chunks and FP16 KV. MTP is enabled with --spec 4 --mtp-max-t 4 --spec-min-p 0.5 and the CJK draft vocabulary; suffix drafts and GDN snapshots stay off. The exact Q6_K/Q4_K/Q5_K/IQ4 batch and IQ4_NL expert kernels are enabled. Model/menu/context measurements are historical; current MTP speed and numerical gates use IQ3_S on the M2 Max in Low Power Mode. Other models use the same format-based kernels, but their whole-model MTP speed must be measured separately. Placeholders are filled by setup.
measured_on: Historical model/menu/context measurements: Apple M2 Max (38-core GPU, 96 GB), macOS 26.5, Xcode 26.1, plugged in, Energy Mode Automatic
mtp_measured_on: IQ3_S MTP and exact batch kernels: Apple M2 Max (38-core GPU, 96 GiB), macOS 26.5, existing Low Power Mode retained, 2026-10-11/12
evidence: bench/results/2026-10-04-metal-models/ (IQ2_XS, Q2_0), bench/results/2026-10-04-metal-vision/ (images), bench/results/2026-10-04-metal-128k/ (128K context), bench/results/2026-10-04-metal-256k/ (256K context), bench/results/2026-10-11-metal-mtp-kernel-optimization/ (IQ3_S MTP, short/10K/cached numerical audit)
